name: Dre*m C Club ~Shin'ya Himitsu Houshi~
source:
This is a novel adventure game based on the very popular game, "Dream Club."

The Dream Club is a social place where only pure hearted men can enter.
The main character gained a member card by chance a year ago, and became a regular customer since.
It was truly a dream time...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE055702.html]DLsite English[/url]]
